questions.stem: Which number is a member of the set {2, 4, 6, 8}?
questions.solution: The set consists of even numbers. Only '6' is an even number and part of the set.
questions.explanation: To identify members of a set, compare each element in the set to the options provided.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be selecting odd numbers like '1', '3', which are not in the given even number set.

questions.stem: Which letter is a member of the set {'A', 'E', 'I', 'O', 'U'}?
questions.solution: The set consists of vowels. Only 'E' is a vowel and part of the set.
questions.explanation: Match each element in the set to the given options, focusing on vowels.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be selecting consonants like 'B', 'C', or 'D', which are not included in the vowel set.

questions.stem: Which shape is a member of the set {circle, square, triangle, rectangle}?
questions.solution: The set consists of basic geometric shapes. Only 'Rectangle' is a shape in the set.
questions.explanation: Identify the shape that matches one of the elements in the given set, focusing on basic shapes.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be selecting non-basic shapes like 'Oval', 'Pentagon', or 'Hexagon'.

questions.stem: Which month is a member of the set {January, March, May, July}?
questions.solution: The set includes months with 31 days. Only 'July' is in this set.
questions.explanation: Match each month to its presence in the given set of months, focusing on 31-day months.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be selecting February, which has 28 or 29 days.

questions.stem: Which number is a member of the prime numbers set {2, 3, 5, 7, 11}?
questions.solution: The set consists of prime numbers. Only '11' is a prime number and part of the set.
questions.explanation: Recognize if each number is a prime number and matches an element in the given set, focusing on primes.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be selecting non-prime numbers like 4, 6, or 9.

questions.stem: Which color is a member of the primary colors set {red, blue, yellow}?
questions.solution: The set consists of primary colors. Only 'Red' is a primary color and part of the set.

questions.stem: Which planet is a member of the inner planets set {Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars}?
